summary: Regression-tested the Cognitive Updating multitasking module after the >100% scoring bug fix. Primary regression PASSED: all time-in-range percentages are now clamped and correctly computed (<= 100%). Full workflow (menu -> instructions -> test -> results) works end-to-end, panel switching preserves state, continuous systems keep running when hidden (pressure went 97 -> 113 with pump ON while Objectives tab was active for 5s), comms code entry and parcel drop workflow both work, dashboard shows 12 cards (Cognitive Updating + System Logic READY, others LOCKED), admin settings persist across reload, and System Logic module loads correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: CognitiveUpdating.js line 233: Math.random() < 0.002 per 100ms tick = ~2% per second chance to change required speed - still feels rare/random and not parameterized (was noted last iteration).

CognitiveUpdating.js line 122: cameras' Math.min(targetSec, testDur-5) still collapses to the same time when testDur is very short (30s admin misuse only) - noted last iteration, still present, low priority.

CognitiveUpdating.js: file is 1035 lines - exceeds the 700 line soft limit. Sub-panels (MessagesPanel/ControlsPanel/ObjectivesPanel/SensorsPanel/EnginePanel/NavigationPanel) could be split into separate files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Set cu-easy-duration=30 via /admin for quick auto-end verification (persisted across reload).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Score inflation fix verified: 30-second test with pump ON entire time produced pressure=11.0%, fuel=83.6%, airspeed=3.7%, overall=32.8% - all well under 100%. Refs-based scoring in the interval body (lines 220-260) plus Math.min(100, ...) safety clamp in endTest() (lines 274-276) both applied correctly. All data-testids from previous iterations still functional. Comms code entry gives OK/FAIL, parcel PREPARE->Ready->Drop->Dropped works, upper (messages/objectives/controls) and lower (sensors/engine/navigation) panel tabs all switch and preserve state. Dashboard styling matches CBT professional look. No further action required.
rca of the issue: Prior >100% score bug was fixed by (a) computing newPressure/newSpeed/newTanks as local variables in the setInterval body first, then calling setState(newValue) once, and (b) performing the range-check increments against those local variables (not inside setState updater callbacks that React 18 StrictMode double-invokes). Additional belt-and-suspenders Math.min(100, ...) applied to pressureScore, fuelScore and speedScore in endTest().
